CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 19, 2020

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:07 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bañuelos, Chan, Moreno Garcia, Messina, Sahu, Tang, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea

  Dunkel-Soto arrived at 7:10 P.M.

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea.

D.  REORDERING OF THE AGENDA

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  COMMERCIAL PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT CP-19-12,
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-19-07 & VARIANCE V-19-09
  • 600 West Main Street, Suite 206
  • Applicant: John Huang
  • Request: This is a request for a Commercial Planned Development
  Permit, Conditional Use Permit, and a Variance to establish an
  education center in an existing 1,678 square foot lease space that
  was previously a law office located in the CPD (Commercial Planned
  Development) zone. The Variance is requested for a reduction in the
  number of required on-site parking spaces.
  • Recommended Action: Continue the Public Hearing to November
  2, 2020.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-22, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-20-03 & VARIANCE VAR-20-05
  • 1300 East Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Ruben Gonzalez
  • Request: This is an application for Planned Development Permit PD-
  20-22, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-03, and Variance VAR-20-05
  to establish a 4,948 square foot Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers
  Restaurant with less than the required land area on a site of
  approximately 57,761 square feet located at 1300 East Valley
  Boulevard in the SRC-VSP (Sub-Regional Commercial-Valley
  Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone.
  1
  10/19/2020
   •  Recommended Action: Continue the Public Hearing to November
  2, 2020.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to reorder the Agenda, addressing Agenda Items 3 and 4 before
  Agenda Item 1, and continue Agenda Items 3 and 4 to the November 2,
  2020, Regular Meeting of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Messina.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Bañuelos, Chan, Dunkel Soto, Moreno Garcia, Messina,
  Sahu, Tang, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  TIME LIMITS:

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to adjourn the meeting at 10:30 PM.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Wang, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Bañuelos, Chan, Dunkel-Soto, Moreno Garcia, Messina,
  Sahu, Tang, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

F.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  EXTENSION OF INDUSTRIAL PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT IP-
  19-2
  • 1140 Westminster Avenue
  • Applicant: Lee Chan
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year time extension for the
  previously approved Industrial Planned Development Permit for the
  construction of a new three-story, 11,465 square foot light industrial
  warehouse on an approximate land area of 15,831 square feet
  located in the IPD (Industrial Planned Development) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 20-28 approving a one-
  year time extension for Industrial Planned Development Permit IP-
  19-2, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Dunkel-
  Soto.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  2
  10/19/2020
   Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Bañuelos, Chan, Dunkel-Soto, Moreno Garcia, Messina,
  Sahu, Tang, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TT 74194, RESIDENTIAL PLANNED
  DEVELOPMENT PERMIT RP-17-7, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-17-
  9 AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
  • 1000 South Fremont Avenue; 2215 West Mission Road; 629, 635,
  701, 825 and 1003 South Date Avenue
  • Applicant: ELITE-TRC Alhambra Community LLC, Elite-TRC
  North Parcel LLC; The Corner Company, LLC
  • Request: This is an application for Vesting Tentative Tract Map TT
  74194, Residential Planned Development Permit RP-17-7,
  Conditional Use Permit CU-17-9 and Development Agreement for
  the development of the proposed Villages at The Alhambra project
  (Project). The Project covers portions of a 38.38-acre site bounded
  by Fremont Avenue (west), Mission Road (south), Date Avenue
  (east), and Orange Street (north) in the City of Alhambra. The Project
  would retain 902,001 square feet of existing office space and would
  repurpose 10,145 square feet of existing office space as Residential
  Amenity space. Also, the Project would retain a 50,000 square-foot
  LA Fitness health club, but would replace existing surface parking
  areas, warehouse/storage/maintenance buildings, and a vacant
  office building with 516 new, for-sale, residential dwelling units in five-
  story stacked flat and townhome configurations; 545 new rental
  apartments in five-story stacked flat configurations; and 4,347 total
  parking spaces to accommodate all new uses. It is expected that if
  the Project is approved the applicant will implement a parking
  reduction pursuant to Alhambra Municipal Code Section 23.52.060.
  The Project site is located in the PO (Professional Office) zone. An
  Environmental Impact Report has been prepared for the Project and
  will also be considered with the Project.
  • Recommended Action: Direct Staff to return the Item on the
  November 2, 2020, Agenda with any additional information the
  Commission requires, as well as a resolution recommending that the
  City Council do one of the following:
  (a) Approve the project as proposed;
  (b) Approve the project with recommended modifications; or
  (c) Deny the project.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Megan Moloughney, Ratkovich; Alex DeGood, Cox Castle; and
  Winston Chang, Next Architecture; Applicant representatives,
  were available to answer questions.
  MOTION:

  3
  10/19/2020
   •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 2 to the November 2, 2020, Regular
  meeting of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dunkel-Soto, Seconded by Commissioner
  Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Bañuelos, Chan, Dunkel-Soto, Moreno Garcia, Messina,
  Sahu, Tang, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT

  •  There was no Director’s Report.

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

J.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  President Gardea inquired about the project on Curtis Avenue regarding compliance
  with SB330 and the affordability requirement, if it had been heard by City Council and
  if there was a final determination. He then encouraged the Commission to register to
  vote.

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 11:48 P.M. to Monday,
  November 2, 2020, at 7:00 P.M.
